status: REGISTERED 2026-11-18: frozen BEFORE any deflation number was computed. Loaders were run for counts only (windows per unit; no losses, ratios or gains printed). Hashes in long_prereg_deflate.sha256.
approval: Research-focused idea v3 (PROGRESS/27, 'Idea gate, research-focused idea v3'); student's word: 'go'.
theory: PROGRESS/32_theory_deflated_quantum_advantage_2026-11-18.md: manufactured gain of best-of-N selection G = r_control - min r_o; prediction G_pred = s x E[M_N] with s the sample standard deviation of the N option results; deflated result = min r_o + G_pred.

in_sample (budgets already seen): copper ladder, DOM/ISING (budget_lib tables; reference chosen on the previous year)
commodity panel, six quantum models (budget3_lib tables, quarters)
out_of_sample (never budgeted): kernels: daily quantum kernels Q_L1-Q_L3 vs 7 classical kernels, 12 assets, 2008-2024 (kern_preds)
adaptive: daily QRC fixed and adaptive vs 7 classical, HG + 7 commodities, eligible years (long_preds_qrc)
hourly_roll: QLSTMT vs LSTM/GRU, Databento copper hourly, roll years with 5 seeds (hourly_databento_preds_v5 roll*)

controls_fixed_now: Quantum control: DOM (copper), QLSTMT (panel, hourly_roll), Q_L2 (kernels), QRC_angle (adaptive). Loss control: MSE (copper, hourly_roll), QLIKE (others). Reference: past-year best (copper), validation-best classical per asset (panel), validation-best classical per block (kernels, adaptive, hourly_roll).
cells: Single-choice protocols with the others at control: WINDOW per unit (options = test windows), SEED per unit where seeded (3-seed subsets), LOSS per unit (3 losses), QMODEL per unit (quantum models), UNIT per dataset (options = units, control = mean).

decision_rules.H1: A cell passes if |deflated - r_control| <= max(0.01, 0.3 x G_pred) in log units; only cells with N >= 4 count. H1 SUPPORTED if at least 75% of out-of-sample cells pass AND each out-of-sample dataset has at least 50% passing. In-sample pass rates are reported, labelled.
decision_rules.H2: Per dataset, Spearman correlation across choices between unit-averaged G_pred and G_obs. H2 SUPPORTED if Spearman >= 0.6 in at least 2 of the 3 out-of-sample datasets.
decision_rules.H1a: Descriptive: sign-flip null median of G vs rms(r) x E[M_N] for every cell.
decision_rules.wording: If H1 is supported: 'a simple expected-maximum deflation, computed from the spread of the options alone, recovers the honest result in X% of out-of-sample cells'. If not: report where it fails (heavy tails, small N, asymmetric control) and do not propose the rule as a deflation tool.

claude_prediction_recorded_for_transpare.text: H1 supported: about 75-85% of out-of-sample cells pass; failures where one year is extreme (2008, 2020) or N is small. H2 supported in 2 of 3 datasets (WINDOW and UNIT have the largest G in kernels and adaptive; hourly_roll has only 3 choices). H1a: the rms rule is within 20% of the sign-flip median.

known_limits: The out-of-sample datasets were analysed in earlier work (their headline comparisons are known; their budgets are not).
Single-choice protocols only; joint protocols are not predicted.
N < 4 cells are excluded from H1.
The tolerance (1 log point or 30%) is a judgement fixed now.
stop_rule: One run, report, stop. No change of tolerance, controls, datasets or cells after results.
